sentences.text: New England is a geographical region comprising six states of the northeast United States : Connecticut , Maine , Massachusetts , New Hampshire , Rhode Island , and Vermont .	Maine	Maine	Vermont	Vermont	Massachusetts	Massachusetts	Connecticut	Connecticut	New Hampshire	New Hampshire	Rhode Island	Rhode Island	northeast United States	northeastern United States	England	Kingdom of England

It is bordered by the state of New York to the west and south , and the Canadian provinces of New Brunswick and Quebec to the northeast and north , respectively .	New York	New York (state)	Canadian provinces	Provinces and territories of Canada	New Brunswick	New Brunswick	Quebec	Quebec
The Atlantic Ocean is to the east and southeast , and Long Island Sound is to the south .	Atlantic Ocean	Atlantic Ocean	Long Island Sound	Long Island Sound
Boston , the capital of Massachusetts , is New England 's largest city .	Boston	Boston	Massachusetts	Massachusetts	England	Kingdom of England

The largest metropolitan area is Greater Boston , which also includes Worcester -LRB- the second-largest city in both Massachusetts and New England -RRB- , Manchester -LRB- the largest city in New Hampshire -RRB- , and Providence -LRB- the capital and largest city of Rhode Island -RRB- , with nearly a third of the entire region 's population . In 1620 , Puritan Separatist Pilgrims from England first settled in the region , forming the Plymouth Colony , the second successful English settlement in the Americas , following the Jamestown Settlement in Virginia founded in 1607 . Over the next 126 years , people in the region fought in four French and Indian Wars , until the British and their Iroquois allies defeated the French and their Algonquin allies in North America .	French and Indian Wars	French and Indian Wars	Iroquois	Iroquois Confederacy	Algonquin	Algonquian peoples

In 1692 , the town of Salem , Massachusetts and surrounding areas experienced one of the most infamous cases of mass hysteria in the history of the Western Hemisphere , the Salem witch trials .	Massachusetts	Massachusetts	mass hysteria	mass hysteria	Western Hemisphere	Western Hemisphere	Salem witch trials	Salem witch trials

In the late 18th century , political leaders from the New England Colonies known as the Sons of Liberty initiated resistance to Britain 's efforts to impose new taxes without the consent of the colonists .	England	Kingdom of England	Sons of Liberty	Sons of Liberty	taxes without the consent of the colonists	No taxation without representation

The Boston Tea Party was a protest to which Britain responded with a series of punitive laws stripping Massachusetts of self-government , which were termed the `` Intolerable Acts '' by the colonists .	Boston	Boston	Massachusetts	Massachusetts	Boston Tea Party	Boston Tea Party	Intolerable Acts	Intolerable Acts

The confrontation led to the first battles of the American Revolutionary War in 1775 , and the expulsion of the British authorities from the region in spring 1776 .	American Revolutionary War	American Revolutionary War

The region played a prominent role in the movement to abolish slavery in the United States , and was the first region of the U.S. transformed by the Industrial Revolution , centered on the Blackstone and Merrimack river valleys .	abolish slavery	Abolitionism in the United States	Industrial Revolution	Industrial Revolution	Blackstone	Blackstone Valley	Merrimack	Merrimack Valley

The physical geography of New England is diverse for such a small area ; southeastern New England is covered by a narrow coastal plain , while the western and northern regions are dominated by the rolling hills and worn-down peaks of the northern end of the Appalachian Mountains .	England	Kingdom of England	physical geography	physical geography	coastal plain	Atlantic Coastal Plain

With the Atlantic fall line lying so close to the coast , numerous industrial cities were able to take advantage of water power along the numerous rivers , such as the Connecticut River , which bisects the region from north to south . Each state is principally subdivided into small incorporated municipalities known as towns , many of which are governed by town meetings .	towns	New England town
The only unincorporated areas in the region exist in the sparsely populated northern regions of Maine , New Hampshire , and Vermont .	Maine	Maine	Vermont	Vermont	New Hampshire	New Hampshire
The region is one of the U.S. Census Bureau 's nine regional divisions and the only multi-state region with clear , consistent boundaries .	nine regional divisions	Census Bureau Division
